subject: reasoning
question:
Select the letter-cluster from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

NKY, LHU, JEQ, ?, FYI
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/259d8630a9ac11653540776fb8c878efe7c7e39d2fafd27847036c083bb6c14d.png] 

The pattern followed here is : 

 
• (2) is subtracted from the position value of the first letter.
 
• (3) is subtracted from the position value of the second letter.
 
• (4) is subtracted from the position value of the third letter.

So,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/16312e919699ad68c4f13205e36417469dab3d91211ee925c3feca4076657df0.png] 

Hence, **"HBM"** is the correct answer.
